claims.statement: Marchioness of Mantua. She sat for a drawing in 1499 and sought a painting through agents for years.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Correspondence of Isabella d'Este.
